tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dus gtor chen mo'i bdag bskyed phur chen mdzad skabs kyi dbyangs res rol mo sogs kyi phyag len brjed thor btab pa 'phros don dang bcas pa bzhugs so// bla ma dang rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir dus gtor chen mo'i bdag bskyed phur chen mdzad skabs dbyangs res rol mo sogs kyi phyag len brjed thor btab pa la/ nyer drug la byin 'bebs bsdus pa'i bsdus pa/ mngon rtogs 'bring po la dbyangs 'phags mchog ma/ gtso bo bskyed pa'i tshigs bcad gcig la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung / spyan 'dren la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs ring ba/ bstod pa la rang dbyangs thung ba rnams mdzad/ nyer bdun la byin 'bebs 'bring po'i rgyas pa/ mngon rtogs rgyas pa la dbyangs gnang dus ma mdzad pa'i/ steng yang ma/ ye shes sku mchog ma tshigs bcad gcig la 'dur dbyangs/ nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam ma/ e las ma/ gtso bo bskyed pa'i tshigs bcad gcig la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung / yum chen/ rta mgrin/ skye med ma/ 'khor ba phur bu/ hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin/ rang byung ma/ drin can rtsa ba ma/ dam tshig chen mo'i dbyangs gsar rnying gang rigs/ bla med ma/ skye 'gro ma/ thams cad dbang bsdud ma/ dpal gyi pho nya ring ba/ dkyil 'khor phyi rim ma/ shwa na ma ring ba/ de'i las mkhan ma/ 'dzab dbyangs/ byang chung mgor gnyis dang mjug tu dbyangs khor gsum rnams mdzad/ nyer brgyad la byin 'bebs 'bring po'i bsdus pa/ ye shes sku mchog ma'i dbyangs ring tshar gcig /lho nub srin bsnol ma/ gtso bo'i bskyed dbyangs ring mo hūm̐ mdzad/ sgo ma/ dipta tsakra ma/ sgeg cing ma ring ba/ rdo rje sgeg mo ma/ thabs mkhas ma la dbyangs/ 'khril ba'i mchod chen ma/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu'i dbyangs/ gru gsum mthing chen ma/ de dang gnyis med ma/ dzaḥsprul/ dpal gyi pho nya thung ba/ bdag nyid ma/ sa bdag ma/ 'dod chags khros pa ma/ byang chung nyer bdun lugs bzhin/

bsgral mchod skabs/ bstab dbyangs bai ḍū ra sngon mo dang / phyi nang gsang ba ma mdzad/ nyer dgu la bsdus pa'i rgyas pa/ ye shes sku mchog ma tshigs bcad gnyis la 'dur dbyangs/ nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam ma la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung / gtso bo'i bskyed pa'i tshigs bcad gnyis la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung / yang dag don du ma dbyangs khor gnyis/ sgeg cing ma la rang dbyangs thung ba/ gru gsum mthing nag ma la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs thung / shwa na ma thung ba/ kaṅka rda ri/ byang chen ma dbyangs gcig dang bu dbyangs bzhi rnams mdzad/ gnam gang la mngon rtogs bsdus pa mdzad cing / dbyangs lhag ma'i skabs su/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu ma/ 'bar ma/ dang po phud mchod ma/ bdud 'dul gyi mjug gi dang po padma sogs tshig bcad gnyis la dbyangs khor re re/ gtor 'bul bstan skyong skabs/ bka' yi bran g.yog ma dang / dam tshig 'di la sogs tshig rkang drug la rol mo dang bcas 'dur dbyangs mdzad do/ 'di lta bu'i dbyangs rol gyi rnam gzhag rnams khongs su chud par bya ba la gtso bo slob dpon mkhas pa'i ngag dang mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len la 'dris par bya ba nyid mchog tu gces shing / lhag par dbyangs rol gyi yig cha rnams la yang thos bsam yang yang bya ba shin tu gal che ste/ de yang sngon gyi skyes bu chen po sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ bla ma dam pa'i dngos slob shes rab snang ba sogs dang / gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i dngos slob sogs kyi mdzad pa'i rol yig dang / dbyangs yig gi tshogs mang du snang mod kyang / cung zad mi gsal ba'i tshul gyis deng sang gi skye bo rnams kyi spyod yul du 'gyur ba ma mthong la/ deng sang nye bar mkho ba don gnyer rnams kyis thos bsam gyi yul du bgyi bar 'os pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i skor la/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rnga byin 'bebs kyi yi ge dang /

mngon rtogs rol mo'i rkang grangs rnams ma tshang ba med pa snyel tho lta bu'i sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyis phyag bris su gnang 'dug pa'i phyag bris ngo bo la gzhi byas/ kho bos byas pa'i mngon rtogs kyi rol yig tshigs bcad ma dang / dbyangs yig ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ro zhes bya ba sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs kyi sras mchog kun gyi gtsug rgyan gcig pur gyur pa bdag gi bla ma byang chub sems dpa' chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyi phyag bris dang / gtso bor gsung rtsom yang gnang ba yin mod kyang / bdag gi bla ma sems dpa' chen po de nyid ni sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar dang mthun par rtag tu dman cha 'dzin pa nyid gtso bor mdzad pas/ 'di lta bu bdag gi rtsom mi shes so zhes khengs skyung ba'i phyir/ dbyangs yi ge mdzad byang 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po nyid la 'debs par mdzad dgos zhes sngags 'chang nyid kyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'debs par mdzad pa'i dbyangs yig ngo mtshar can de nyid sogs dbyangs rol gyi yi ge rnams ni deng sang gi dus kyi lugs 'di la don gnyer can rnams kyi nan tan snying por bya ba'i yul nyid do/ rdo rje phur pa'i dbyangs yig de dang 'dra ba'i sa skya pa'i chos srung khyad par can rnams kyi bskang ba dang bstod tshogs kyi dbyangs yig tshangs dbyangs rnga chen zhes bya ba sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyi gsung rtsom dang phyag bris gnyis ka gnang ba la 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos mdzad byang 'debs par mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang chos skyong gi skor la sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i dus gtor so so'i phyag len gyi rim pa dang mthun par dbyangs rol gyi yi ge dang / rgyal sras grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyi mdzad pa'i mgon po drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog gi dbyangs rol gyi yi ge

yang sngags 'chang des mdzad pa'i phur bzlog gi dbyangs rol gyi yi ge dang / gu ru drag po'i dbyangs rol gyi yi ge yang yod/ mtshungs med sngags 'chang yab sras de gnyis kyi gsung rab de rnams phyogs cig tu bsgrigs pa lta bu'i 'jam dbyangs bsod rnams dbang pos mdzad pa'i rol yig gcig shes kun grol zhes bya ba rnams yod do/ 'di lta bu'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i dbyangs dang rol mo'i phyag len khyad par can 'di rnams ma 'chugs par tshul bzhin du bgyis pa la byin rlabs phan yon ngo mtshar can yod pa'i lo rgyus dang tshul lugs 'di nyid rig pa'i gnas chen lnga'i nang nas bzo rig gi khongs su 'dus tshul/ bzo rig la yang lus bzo/ ngag bzo/ yid bzo gsum las/ lugs 'di ngag bzo rol mo'i phyag len yin pa'i tshul/ de la yang lhan cig skyes dang / rkyen gzhan las byung ba gnyis yod pa'i tshul rgyu mtshan des na dbyangs yig nyid kyang rol yig tu 'gyur ba'i tshul sogs tshad ldan mkhas pa'i gsung rab nas 'byung ba'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i legs bshad bsam gyi mi khyab pa zhig 'byung mod kyang 'dir yi ge 'jigs nas ma spros so/ shes par 'dod na de dag gi rgyas bshad kho bos logs su bshad pa las shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa byams pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis bla brang bde mchog pho brang du bris pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dus gtor chen mo'i bdag bskyed phur chen gyi dbyangs rol sogs kyi phyag len brjed thor btab pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
